title: [Locksmehr River, Encampment]
description: Nestled amid wild boxwood and blueberry bushes, a domed sinew and hide tent is flanked by a pair of dormant torches.  Wild river grasses stand out at odd angles along a single muddy track that leads to the center of the encampment, the tamped down and broken blades a testament to recent foot traffic.  Various colored tufts of fleece cling to nearby branches and sway as the breeze of the river moves them about.

Nestled amid the skeletons of boxwood and blueberry bushes, a domed sinew and hide tent is flanked by a pair of burning torches.  Dried out river grasses are broken at odd angles along a single slush-covered track that leads to the center of the encampment, the footprints left in the dusting of snow a testament to the foot traffic.  Various colored tufts of fleece cling to nearby bare branches and tangle themselves between pelts of thick fur and leather.
